anglers_hat.description: Adds one level of Lure and Luck of the Sea while fishing.

antidote_vessel.description: Clears poison and wither once every ten seconds.

aqua_dashers.description: Sprint across water; stop sprinting or sneak to dive.

bunny_hoppers.description: Higher jumps, five extra safe-fall blocks and half fall damage.

charm_of_shrinking.description: Shrinks the wearer to half size.

charm_of_sinking.description: Sink toward the bottom underwater; adds oxygen reserve.

chorus_totem.description: Consumed to rescue you from a lethal hit and teleport to nearby safe ground.

cloud_in_a_bottle.description: Press jump again while airborne for one extra jump.

cowboy_hat.description: Your living mount moves 25% faster while you ride it.

cross_necklace.description: Extends the brief invulnerability after taking a hit.

digging_claws.description: Doubles block-breaking speed and harvests stone-tier pickaxe blocks with your claws.

eternal_steak.description: Reusable food. One-minute cooldown after eating.

everlasting_beef.description: Reusable food. One-minute cooldown after eating.

fire_gauntlet.description: Melee hits ignite permitted targets for four seconds.

flame_pendant.description: Ignites permitted melee attackers for four seconds. Five-second cooldown.

golden_hook.description: Mobs you defeat drop 50% more experience.

helium_flamingo.description: Hold sprint in midair to swim through the air for up to eight seconds. Recharges on the ground.

kitty_slippers.description: Nearby creepers and phantoms avoid you unless you attack them.

lucky_scarf.description: Adds one level of Fortune to block drops.

night_vision_goggles.description: Night vision while worn; fades within twelve seconds after removal.

novelty_drinking_hat.description: Eat and drink twice as quickly.

obsidian_skull.description: After fire hurts you, grants ten seconds of fire resistance. Thirty-second cooldown.

onion_ring.description: Eating while wearing this grants Haste for ten seconds per food point.

panic_necklace.description: Taking damage grants Speed II for five seconds. Ten-second cooldown.

pickaxe_heater.description: Automatically smelts mined drops using their furnace recipes.

plastic_drinking_hat.description: Eat and drink twice as quickly.

rooted_boots.description: Standing still on grass restores food; eating encourages nearby plants to grow.

running_shoes.description: Twenty-five percent faster sprinting and one-block step height.

scarf_of_invisibility.description: Invisibility while worn; armor remains visible.

shock_pendant.description: Resists lightning and shocks permitted melee attackers for 3 damage. Five-second cooldown.

snowshoes.description: Walk over powder snow, resist freezing and move faster on snow.

steadfast_spikes.description: Strong knockback resistance and firm footing on slippery ice.

strider_shoes.description: Sneak to walk on lava; protects against hot floors.

superstitious_hat.description: Adds one level of Looting to mobs you defeat.

thorn_pendant.description: Returns 2 damage to permitted melee attackers. Three-second cooldown.

umbrella.description: A gliding umbrella that also blocks attacks.

universal_attractor.description: Draws nearby loose items toward you. Respects claims and pickup ownership.

vampiric_glove.description: Melee hits heal 20% of damage, at most one heart per second.

villager_hat.description: Villagers offer their friendly reputation discount while worn.

warp_drive.description: Throw ender pearls for two food points instead of consuming them; prevents pearl damage.

whoopee_cushion.description: Sneak to surprise everyone nearby with a familiar sound.

withered_bracelet.description: Melee hits inflict Wither for three seconds. Five-second cooldown.
